Kevin's does everything. He runs Kingdom Construction on a single app he built on Hercules, BuilderSuite Pro. It handles:

* CRM and quoting
* Invoicing
* Construction management
* Jobsite cameras
* Internal chat

Kevin, Founder, Kingdom Construction
